verdict.rationale: Angular is distributed as code you install and run yourself: its source is on GitHub, the CLI installs locally via npm, and it builds and serves applications on the user's own machine into a local dist/ output. No hosted vendor service is required. missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, explicit docs on fully offline/air-gapped use, independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Install the Angular CLI globally: npm install -g @angular/cli
Compiles an Angular application or library into an output directory named dist/ at the given output path.
Builds and serves your application, rebuilding on file changes.
Angular is a development platform for building mobile and desktop web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and other languages.
